events.title: Le Festival 2026 – Brisbane French Festival
events.description: A vibrant celebration of French culture featuring live music, art, and language stalls in a public park setting. Expect an immersive atmosphere with opportunities for cultural exchange.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane – Exhibitions and Programs
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane City
events.description: Explore rotating exhibitions focusing on the history, art, and creative soul of Brisbane. The museum frequently hosts artist talks and workshops that foster local community connection.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical at QPAC
events.description: A high-production-value musical adaptation offering significant creative and artistic performance design. Suitable for those interested in modern theatrical spectacle and storytelling.

events.title: The Book of Mormon at QPAC
events.description: A sharp, satirical musical known for its biting commentary and rapid-fire dialogue. A professional production that serves as a provocative piece of contemporary theatre.
